concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-012 ('The system MUST adopt the stratification rule defined in FR-009 (by gas type) for all cross‑validation splits') is not referenced in any plan phase or script. The plan discusses stratified CV (FR‑009, SC‑008) but does not explicitly state compliance with FR‑012, leaving this FR unbacked.
